translations.web: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
translations.bsb: And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?
translations.kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
